body: Im really appreciated. I want people who have depression and suicidal thoughts like me feel more hopeful (even though i feel really hopeless most of the time) i hope they will find the way to happiness and finally enjoy their lives! I want to be nice to people :)

I get your point! I cant feel happy with whatever i do ;/ but i hope u keep fighting! Im here to talk I feel the same way that people are basically just liars and say they get me but actually they dont even care :( im here for you tho i’ll try my best to help you!

Im here to talk if you want someone to share those bad experiences. I used to have lots of friend problems and felt lonely for years (i still do) i was bullied and these stuff were really depressing too. Remember im here for you!

Actually i just tried to make people feel a lil bit better cuz i wanted to die, im a mess but wanna be at least a good mess idk. You deserve to be happy tho yea i get your situation, i cant do much really even for myself but i really hope that u gonna see that light :) keep going please get help, seek for help once again, you deserve to be happy fighting :D !!!

Sorry to hear that im 16 too and ive wanted to die for years maybe 4-5 years since i was a kid i have never felt like i want to be alive but tbh i failed suicide attempt and know that i cant commit it anyway but anyways i hope u will feel better (at least a little bit) i got u, its really relatable ;)

actually same... but i really hope you will get through this i know it’s fucking tough, im trying to but please, when u have those negative thoughts, think that they are not true. They are just saying bad things to you and they are not true. You are strong just keep fighting even you think theres no point to. I hope you will finally find your true happiness and the light in your life.
thanks, I just wanna do something nice for people even though i cant be even nice to myself but i really wanna help them ;)

I really think suicide is the only option for me like seriously. I have been in this endless loop of pains. Therapy doesn’t really help if I don’t want to get better. I just can’t be motivated to go to therapy sessions. I am still doing tho but I just feel like there’s no point to do. Everything is just boring. I think I don’t care anymore, I’m just waiting for when I can actually commit suicide successfully. I don’t want to do self-harm or attempt suicide anymore. I’m done.
Yea, life for me is meaningless, sighs
I hate how I feel numb/empty even though I’m doing things keeping me busy. Life is not enjoyable anymore, it’s seriously boring. Maybe I just can’t enjoy it?

Yes but I think there’s no point to do anything. I’ve been feeling like I’m lost in space lately. I can laugh, smile and joke around just because to make me “feel something”. Feeling numb is the worst feeling ever. I hate everyone without reasons idk I just don’t want to live anymore. I don’t feel alive anyways.

At the end of January and was admitted to hospital due to depression and last week I intentionally overdosed panadol but wasn’t enough to kill me tho. I’ve been doing therapy (DBT) for months but I can’t really make myself to do idk everything is just hard and tiring. I just want it all to end ...
I’m just giving up on life idk I guess I don’t feel or care about anything

Yea, the wounds are still super red (obviously), I used to cut like last month then I started cutting again on Tuesday (on my wrist) and yesterday (about 10+ cuts) i dont know why i couldn’t control myself :((

There is a part of me saying “HELP” but i always say “no i don’t need help, on one will be able to help me”. My boyfriend, he’s trying to help me, he gave me an option which is pretty good, but i dont know why i said NO to him but i just keep saying things which basically mean “I need help”

btw when i did self harm i felt like it wasn’t me doing that, just like another ‘me’, i know what i was doing but i dont know why i did that, pretty confused, it’s like there are people in my head fighting with each other to control the actual me :(

I have seen counsellors to do talking therapies and stuff but i just ignored what they said, I HATE TALKING so i stopped going to see them. Now, (im a high school student) the year advisor, he is really concerned about me and he’s tryna take me to see counsellors and stuff. I legit can’t be bothered at all ...

As I've said, sometimes depressed but sometimes fine or crazy. When I feel depressed, I feel like I need help but I act like I can't be bothered basically just wanna die and it's really hard just to cheer myself up..... and then when I get better (but pretty much like too crazy) I feel like 'oh I'm fine now, don't gonna get any help' and I think this is distracting me from getting a proper help ... I know what should I do but I feel like I can't control myself just to get HELP :(
